quotes.text: Tests commonly assert observable state with a specific failure message and clean up changed prefs, servers, or windows. A review on D324413 asked for separate assertions so failures report their values; the landed compose test uses separate alignment and size checks. https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D324413 and https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/f76d3fa1c71103e8d522b
